name: Achilló
subtitle: Jon's Achilles rehab log
description: Private AltStore source for the Achilló rehab app. Builds are published by the app's build script.

apps.name: Achilló
apps.subtitle: Guided Achilles rehab, by ear
apps.localizedDescription: Daily post-op Achilles program: BFR, Chris's barefoot and boot-on routines, hourly quick ones, hinge ladder, imagery. Audio cues keep going with the screen locked; reminders come from the app.

versions.localizedDescription:
Quick one is back on the watch. The start screen shows the next quick one by name and highlights it when one is due.
Haptic textures on the watch: ticks speed up as you rise, slow down as you lower, and a heartbeat pulses through holds.
Haptic textures on the watch: ticks speed up as you rise, slow down as you lower, and a heartbeat pulses through holds. Turn them on or off with Textures on the watch start screen.

Boot-on PT is gone from the app.
Watch taps are stronger. Each cue is now a firmer, doubled tap. On the watch start screen, set Taps to Normal, Strong or Max.
Skipping a rest on the phone now updates the watch too.
